hero_concept.hook: The shirt we wear on every pack walk.
hero_concept.headline: Made For Dog People
hero_concept.primary_text:
Every DentalMelt and ZenMelt starts the same way: a walk with our own dogs, arguing about what to try next.

This is the shirt we wear on those walks. Soft cotton, unisex fit, the PetPax paw across the chest so other dog people know you're one of them.

Free shipping on any order over $40. Add one to your next box.
hero_concept.visual_direction: The tee laid flat on a wooden bench next to a leash, a tennis ball, and a bag of DentalMelts, shot from above in soft morning light.
hero_concept.fills_gap: Right now every single ad you run sells DentalMelts or ZenMelts, so your account has no way to show shoppers there is a real brand behind the products. A still image of a shirt breaks the wall of talking-head videos and gives a low-price way to get people onto your site who are not ready to buy chews yet.
hero_concept.image_prompt: A photorealistic editorial product photograph featuring the product from the reference image, styled in a flat-lay on a warm wooden bench beside a leather leash, a well-loved tennis ball, and a small pouch of dog treats, with soft natural morning light coming from the upper left casting gentle shadows. Warm, earthy, dog-owner-at-home aesthetic that feels lived-in and honest rather than studio-perfect. Square 1:1 composition with breathing room top and bottom for ad text overlay. CRITICAL - preserve the exact colorway of the short-sleeve unisex cotton t-shirt as shown in the reference image AND every printed graphic, logo, and text element on the garment exactly as printed, strictly NO color shift, NO fabric-tone drift, NO recoloring of the print, NO removing of the print, NO changing print placement. STRUCTURE - preserve the exact construction: standard crew neckline, short sleeves ending at mid-bicep, straight unisex regular fit, single-piece body with side seams, printed brand label at the back of the neck if visible, and PRESERVE the front chest printed graphic exactly as shown including every illustration, every word of text, every color, and the same size and placement on the chest. Do NOT add a pocket, do NOT change to a V-neck or henley, do NOT alter sleeve length to long or cap, do NOT change to a fitted or cropped silhouette, do NOT remove the chest print, do NOT redraw or restyle the graphic, do NOT change the graphic's colors, do NOT relocate the print. Render the product's fabric, weave, color, printed graphics AND every visible construction detail (silhouette, neckline, sleeves, printed graphics) EXACTLY as they appear in the reference image. Do NOT change the color, do NOT shift the color temperature, do NOT introduce tones not present in the reference, do NOT add or remove any hardware, do NOT alter the silhouette, do NOT remove or modify printed graphics or text on the garment. IMPORTANT: the 'no text' and 'no logos' items in the NEGATIVE list below apply ONLY to text or logos added as overlay to the photograph itself - text, logos, graphics, prints, and brand labels that exist ON the product in the reference image are part of the product and must be preserved exactly. Premium commerce photography quality. NEGATIVE: no overlay text added to the photograph, no overlay logos added to the photograph, no watermarks, no UI elements, no Facebook interface, no clickable buttons, no faces, no models, no collage, no borders, no duplicate products, no color shift, no metal swap, no silver-to-gold or gold-to-silver conversion, no warm-tone bias on cool metals, no recoloring of fabric or stones, no pattern modifications, no removing or replacing the product's printed graphics, no extra hardware not present in reference, no added pockets or pleats, no silhouette alterations, no design modifications.
